literal_meaning: ভস্ম (অংশ) + কীট (কীটপতঙ্গ); অর্থাৎ ভস্ম খাওয়া কীট
figurative_meaning_bn: যে কীটের ক্ষুধা সহজে নিবৃত্ত হয় না
figurative_meaning_en: An insect whose hunger is never easily satisfied, referring to someone with an insatiable appetite
example_sentences_in_bangla: এত খাই খাই করছ কেন? পেটে ভস্মকীট ঢুকেছে নাকি?
সে যেন ভস্মকীটের মতো খেতে থাকে, কখনো পেট ভরে না।
example_sentences_in_english: Why are you eating so much? Do you have an ash insect in your stomach?
He eats like he has an ash insect inside, never getting full.
history: This idiom draws from traditional Bengali folklore describing mythical insects with endless hunger, symbolizing gluttony in rural storytelling.
note: The idiom metaphorically implies excessive or unending hunger, often used humorously in casual settings.
